Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Share Value Rose While Stack Financial Management Has Raised by $1.23 Million Its Stake; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Rose, Shareholder Cumberland Partners LTD Lowered Stake
June 14, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Stack Financial Management Inc increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd. (SLB) by 5.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stack Financial Management Inc bought 19,228 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 395,863 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $25.64 million, up from 376,635 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stack Financial Management Inc who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $94.78 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.67% or $0.46 during the last trading session, reaching $68.43. About 4.72M shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 1.14% since June 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.71% the S&P500.
Andrew Wallach decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 95.53% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cumberland Partners Ltd sold 48,297 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Andrew Wallach held 2,260 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $379,000, down from 50,557 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
